import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
# baseline: days except 10-13, 10-14, 10-15? First compare day-over-day and vs typical
base = df[(df['date'] >= '2025-09-13') & (df['date'] <= '2025-10-12')]
anom = df[df['date'] == '2025-10-13']
print("rows base:", len(base), "rows anom:", len(anom))

# aggregate by resource dims
for dim in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    b = base.groupby(dim)['unblended_cost'].sum()
    a = anom.groupby(dim)['unblended_cost'].sum()
    comp = pd.DataFrame({'base': b, 'anom': a}).fillna(0)
    comp['diff'] = comp['anom'] - comp['base']
    print("\n==", dim)
    print(comp.sort_values('diff', ascending=False).head(10))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
anom = df[df['date']=='2025-10-13'].set_index('instance_family')

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
base = df[(df['date']>='2025-10-01')&(df['date']<='2025-10-12')]
# per-family price and num_instances means
p = base.groupby('instance_family').agg(pmean=('price','mean'), nmean=('num_instances','mean'))

comp = pd.DataFrame({'price': anom['price'], 'ninst': anom['num_instances']}).join(p)
comp['dp'] = (comp['price'] - comp['pmean']) / comp['pmean']
comp['dn'] = (comp['ninst'] - comp['nmean']) / comp['nmean']
print("price outliers:", comp[comp['dp'].abs()>0.1][['price','pmean']].to_string())
print("numinst outliers (top):")
print(comp.sort_values('dn', ascending=False).head(5)[['ninst','nmean']])
